records.words: I remember the walks and the single lines I could not answer. I want to visit someone before making the harvest call this time; I want to hear an answer to me.

Twenty game minutes until arrival and 130 until home: now I can tell what the walk means. On the phone the walking sentence is cut short, but the house controls are easy to read. I will leave the reading view so I actually get there.

I went to Ak before calling the harvest, hoping to answer their greeting. One thirty-second wait has taken me home and into the storm two days later. I missed the entire visit. That is much faster than I remember, and I have not changed speed. I want to find what they said in Earlier replies.
A baby, and an invitation rather than an order. Yes, I want to go. I will watch in shorter pieces this time; I do not want to miss this too.
There it is: I came to listen. I am glad I opened the house again. Gülsüm has a name, and I would rather hear about her than make a demand while visiting a newborn.

I said I came to listen before I had heard him speak. Then God is generous appeared, and in the next few seconds I was already home. I cannot tell whether he heard my answer or whether I spoke too soon. I wanted a conversation, but I am chasing the clock and switching panels. I would stop here.

I am stopping at home after visiting the newborn at the Çoban house. I liked being invited and learning her name, Gülsüm. I finally had words to say, but I do not know whether Yusuf answered them, and the visit was over before I could follow it. I would not return voluntarily tonight or leave it running. I might return another evening if I could follow a visit without losing it between panels; I still want to know these people. I selected the confused choice locally; it filled the note box itself. I typed nothing and pressed no Submit.
